scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
Sealed in the underground
of the Prontera Castle...
I didn't expect it to be this huge...

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: What on earth is there inside?

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: I don't know. Let's investigate the inside, first.

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
This...this must be...
Ymir's Heart!

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
This...
This is Ymir's Heart...
~Rumbling~

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Why is this place shaking?!

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: ~Grunts~ They must've started attacking this place, too.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: ~Grins~ Delighted to see you all.

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
!!
You've got to be kidding me!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
From this moment on, we the Immortal Legion by Lord Valkyrie Himelmez
will take over here.

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
What? How dare you!
I'm game. Bring it on!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
~Grins~ Do I look like I have the time to deal with a petty thing like you, human?
But, out of pure mercy, I'll let you taste the fearful power of the Immortal Legion just a little bit.

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: ~Grunts~ When did all the legionnaires get here?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: ~Chuckles~ I think you're not that bad for a human.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: But do you think you can get away from this, again? Wake up, my underlings!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: What...what's up with this monster?!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Ah...
I'll let you in on me before I go.
I'm Bijou.
I'm the adjutant to Lord Valkyrie Himelmez.

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
~Groans~
No Valkyrie's subordinates ever disappointed me and neither did you.
Ymir's Heart is a huge energy source. For what do you want to use it anyway?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
......
You don't need to know. You're going to be wiped out soon anyway.

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
I don't think you'd use it for any good cause.
I'll stop Bijou from taking Ymir's Heart. You go ahead and take care of that huge monster!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
Was that it...? Has it gone now?
So what's left now is...

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: Me...I'm the only one left...

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: What?!
~POW!~

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Aaarrghhh---!!!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
I must say it was rather unexpected. ~Chuckles~
I didn't expect anyone to defeat Amdarais that I spent three good years to complete.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
You will pay
for ruining my three-year efforts!!
Slowly...
And horribly painfully...!!

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: ~Groans~ I can't believe nothing seems to work!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
~Chuckles~
I'll let you taste what despair feels like.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: Frost Diver!

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: ~Groans~

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
How does it feel? Painful, eh?
You must become paralyzed by now.
...But don't expect me to kill you that easily...

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: I should take care of this downright annoying cleric gal first.

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: I...Iris!!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: Sarah...?

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text:
So this is it...
This is the underground of Prontera Castle.
The place where the first Ymir's Heart is sealed.

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text:
And that must be...
Ymir's Heart...

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
What brought you all the way up here?
Sarah Irine.
I didn't expect you would show up here.

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text: What do you think you're doing here, Bijou?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: Yes, I was in the middle of taking care of the annoying bugs.

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text: What kind of answer is that, Bijou?

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text: My question was: what are you still doing here, totally goofing off, and, why didn't you break any sealing off of Ymir's Heart?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Well, that's uh...I did break the 1st seal, though.
This place will be cleaned up in no time. There is nothing for you to worry about, Sarah.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: Trust me and consider it done. Please be yourself as proud Valkyrie.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: (~Scoffs~ What an uptight, pathetic Valkyrie she is! I can't believe a greenhorn like you are treated the same as Himelmez. That is so unfair.)

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text: You must be out of your mind, Bijou...There is no Himelmez here.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
....~Gasps~
I'm out of breath!

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text: You'd better keep your mouth shut!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
~Coughs~
~Keeps coughing~

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text:
I can certainly do without a subordinate who wastes time for this kind of petty job.
Let me take that Ymir's Heart...myself.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: (She is Valkyrie, indeed. Oh, what can you do about that?)

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
The time is right!
Frost Diver!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: What did you say?!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Whoa...That was a close; call.
How could this happen?

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
This magic...
This must be high-level magic as I expected. It's pretty tough to cast it.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: (What is this?! Did she just master the magic that I used on her?)

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
Iris! This is a healing potion.
Drink it and you'll come to your senses.

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: ~Muffled sound~

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: Oh, you woke up now?

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
Umm....
~Vomiting sound~
Yuck! Is this bitter!
What the heck is this?!
What did you give to me?

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
So you woke up, Iris.
I'm so relieved.

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
~Sighs~ By the way, Fenrir!
What about Ymir's Heart?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: (...Fenrir? I thought too much about Ymir's Heart and totally forgot about her. If my guess is right, she must be...!)

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
~Exhales~ I see. That's right.
That beast's blood flowing through your body...That was the answer!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Then, let me serve you the right way! ~Chuckles~
I didn't expect to see the hero from a thousand years ago!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: Die!!

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: ...Be careful. She's about to attack!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: ~Grunts~

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
~Evil laughter~ Die!
Clerics deserve to die!

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
Iris!!
No! Stop!!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
~Chuckles~
So you're looking for a partner, eh?
Good idea, but...I think it's too late.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Because...
This will be the final, fatal blow to you. Wahahaha!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
....~Sighs~
Huh?...In my stomach...
This knife...
Sa...Sarah...? How?

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text:
Is that all you want to say?
Don't worry. I'll let Himelmez know of your brave contribution. Don't blame me, Bijou.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Why...? Tell me why!
...That...that little chick...Was that it? Because she's your sister? Was that it? Tell me, Sarah!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: ~Groans~

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text:
......
Your soul has been set free, Bijou.

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: (Did she save me...?)

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
Sarah...
It's Sarah, right?
People say we parted when we were little...

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
...So what's your plan, huh? Why...why did you save me?!
Don't you ever think this will ever change my belief! I will never, ever forgive you!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Mom...Dad...Every people in our town. I'm going to revenge!

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text:
Shut that mouth!
Don't be a drama queen as if you're the only victim here.
They just paid the price for what they sinned. The sin that they committed by killing my mother 12 years ago.

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text: Do you want me to tell you the truth? Those 'loved ones' you're incessantly talking about...Our great elder and the people in our town were actually...

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text:
......
Stop it...
Ymir's Heart comes first, no matter what.

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text:
Mark my word.
I didn't let you live.
I will let you die soon.
I make sure you no longer see the light of day the next time when we meet.

scripts.speaker: Sarah
scripts.text:
Don't you ever let anyone kill you until then, Iris.
I'd better bid farewell for today, then.

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: ~Grunts~ That Valkyrie destroyed the ceiling when taking Ymir's Heart!

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: We'd better get out of here, too! This place is too dangerous!
